options.name: accessrestrictedpageredirect
options.description: By default, an access restricted page hosted on secure private access C(CDN) is displayed when a restricted app is accessed. The setting can be changed to C(NS) to display the access restricted page hosted on the gateway or C(OFF) to not display any access restricted page.

options.name: advancedclientlessvpnmode
options.description: Option to enable/disable Advanced ClientlessVpnMode. Additionaly, it can be set to C(STRICT) to block Classic ClientlessVpnMode while in AdvancedClientlessMode.

options.name: allowedlogingroups
options.description: Specify groups that have permission to log on to Citrix Gateway. Users who do not belong to this group or groups are denied access even if they have valid credentials.

options.name: allprotocolproxy
options.description: IP address of the proxy server to use for all protocols supported by Citrix Gateway.

options.name: alwaysonprofilename
options.description: Name of the AlwaysON profile. The builtin profile named none can be used to explicitly disable AlwaysON.

options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: apptokentimeout
options.description: The timeout value in seconds for tokens to access XenMobile applications

options.name: authorizationgroup
options.description: Comma-separated list of groups in which the user is placed when none of the groups that the user is a part of is configured on Citrix Gateway. The authorization policy can be bound to these groups to control access to the resources.

options.name: autoproxyurl
options.description: URL to auto proxy config file

options.name: backendcertvalidation
options.description: enables backend server certificate validation

options.name: backenddtls12
options.description: Enables DTLS 1.2 for backend server handshakes

options.name: backendserversni
options.description: enables sni extension for backend server handshakes

options.name: citrixreceiverhome
options.description: Web address for the Citrix Receiver home page. Configure Citrix Gateway so that when users log on to the appliance, the Citrix Gateway Plug-in opens a web browser that allows single sign-on to the Citrix Receiver home page.

options.name: clientchoices
options.description: Provide users with multiple logon options. With client choices, users have the option of logging on by using the Citrix Gateway Plug-in for Windows, Citrix Gateway Plug-in for Java, the Web Interface, or clientless access from one location. Depending on how Citrix Gateway is configured, users are presented with up to three icons for logon choices. The most common are the Citrix Gateway Plug-in for Windows, Web Interface, and clientless access.

options.name: clientcleanupprompt
options.description: Prompt for client-side cache clean-up when a client-initiated session closes.

options.name: clientconfiguration
options.description: Allow users to change client Debug logging level in Configuration tab of the Citrix Gateway Plug-in for Windows.

options.name: clientdebug
options.description: Set the trace level on Citrix Gateway. Technical support technicians use these C(debug) logs for in-depth debugging and troubleshooting purposes. Available settings function as follows: * DEBUG - Detailed C(debug) messages are collected and written into the specified file. * STATS - Application audit level error messages and C(debug) statistic counters are written into the specified file. * EVENTS - Application audit-level error messages are written into the specified file. * C(OFF) - Only criti

options.name: clientidletimeout
options.description: Time, in minutes, after which to time out the user session if Citrix Gateway does not detect mouse or keyboard activity.

options.name: clientlessmodeurlencoding
options.description: When clientless access is enabled, you can choose to encode the addresses of internal web applications or to leave the address as clear text. Available settings function as follows: * C(OPAQUE) - Use standard encoding mechanisms to make the domain and protocol part of the resource unclear to users. * C(TRANSPARENT) - Do not encode the web address and make it visible to users. * C(ENCRYPT) - Allow the domain and protocol to be encrypted using a session key. When the web address is encrypted, the

options.name: clientlesspersistentcookie
options.description: State of persistent cookies in clientless access mode. Persistent cookies are required for accessing certain features of SharePoint, such as opening and editing Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint documents hosted on the SharePoint server. A persistent cookie remains on the user device and is sent with each HTTP request. Citrix Gateway encrypts the persistent cookie before sending it to the plug-in on the user device, and refreshes the cookie periodically as long as the session exists. The coo

options.name: clientlessvpnmode
options.description: Enable clientless access for web, XenApp or XenDesktop, and FileShare resources without installing the Citrix Gateway Plug-in. Available settings function as follows: * C(ON) - Allow only clientless access. * C(OFF) - Allow clientless access after users log on with the Citrix Gateway Plug-in. * C(DISABLED) - Do not allow clientless access.

options.name: clientoptions
options.description: Display only the configured menu options when you select the "Configure Citrix Gateway" option in the Citrix Gateway Plug-in's system tray icon for Windows.

options.name: clientsecurity
options.description: Specify the client security check for the user device to permit a Citrix Gateway session. The web address or IP address is not included in the expression for the client security check.

options.name: clientsecuritygroup
options.description: The client security group that will be assigned on failure of the client security check. Users can in general be organized into Groups. In this case, the Client Security Group may have a more restrictive security policy.

options.name: clientsecuritylog
options.description: Specifies whether or not to display all failed Client Security scans to the end user

options.name: clientsecuritymessage
options.description: The client security message that will be displayed on failure of the client security check.

options.name: clientversions
options.description: checkversion api

options.name: defaultauthorizationaction
options.description: Specify the network resources that users have access to when they log on to the internal network. The default setting for authorization is to deny access to all network resources. Citrix recommends using the default global setting and then creating authorization policies to define the network resources users can access. If you set the default authorization policy to C(DENY), you must explicitly authorize access to any network resource, which improves security.

options.name: deviceposture
options.description: Enable device posture

options.name: dnsvservername
options.description: Name of the DNS virtual server for the user session.

options.name: emailhome
options.description: Web address for the web-based email, such as Outlook Web Access.

options.name: encryptcsecexp
options.description: Enable encryption of client security expressions.

options.name: epaclienttype
options.description: Choose between two types of End point Windows Client a) Application Agent - which always runs in the task bar as a standalone application and also has a supporting service which runs permanently when installed b) Activex Control - ActiveX control run by Microsoft Internet Explorer.

options.name: forcecleanup
options.description: Force C(cache) clean-up when the user closes a session. You can specify C(all), C(none), or any combination of the client-side items.

options.name: forcedtimeout
options.description: Force a disconnection from the Citrix Gateway Plug-in with Citrix Gateway after a specified number of minutes. If the session closes, the user must log on again.

options.name: forcedtimeoutwarning
options.description: Number of minutes to warn a user before the user session is disconnected.

options.name: fqdnspoofedip
options.description: Spoofed IP address range that can be used by client for FQDN based split tunneling

options.name: ftpproxy
options.description: IP address of the proxy server to be used for FTP access for all subsequent connections to the internal network.

options.name: gopherproxy
options.description: IP address of the proxy server to be used for GOPHER access for all subsequent connections to the internal network.

options.name: homepage
options.description: Web address of the home page that appears when users log on. Otherwise, users receive the default home page for Citrix Gateway, which is the Access Interface.

options.name: httpport
options.description: Destination port numbers other than port 80, added as a comma-separated list. Traffic to these ports is processed as HTTP traffic, which allows functionality, such as HTTP authorization and single sign-on to a web application to work.

options.name: httpproxy
options.description: IP address of the proxy server to be used for HTTP access for all subsequent connections to the internal network.

options.name: httptrackconnproxy
options.description: Enable or disable HTTP tracking for packets proxied via vpn vserver using GSLB connection proxy feature.

options.name: icaproxy
options.description: Enable ICA proxy to configure secure Internet access to servers running Citrix XenApp or XenDesktop by using Citrix Receiver instead of the Citrix Gateway Plug-in.

options.name: icasessiontimeout
options.description: Enable or disable ica session timeout. If enabled and in case AAA session gets terminated, ICA connections associated with that will also get terminated

options.name: icauseraccounting
options.description: The name of the radiusPolicy to use for RADIUS user accounting info on the session.

options.name: iconwithreceiver
options.description: Option to decide whether to show plugin icon along with receiver icon

options.name: iipdnssuffix
options.description: An intranet IP DNS suffix. When a user logs on to Citrix Gateway and is assigned an IP address, a DNS record for the user name and IP address combination is added to the Citrix Gateway DNS cache. You can configure a DNS suffix to append to the user name when the DNS record is added to the cache. You can reach to the host from where the user is logged on by using the user's name, which can be easier to remember than an IP address. When the user logs off from Citrix Gateway, the record is removed

options.name: kcdaccount
options.description: The KCD account details to be used in SSO

options.name: killconnections
options.description: Specify whether the Citrix Gateway Plug-in should disconnect all preexisting connections, such as the connections existing before the user logged on to Citrix Gateway, and prevent new incoming connections on the Citrix Gateway Plug-in for Windows and MAC when the user is connected to Citrix Gateway and split tunneling is disabled.

options.name: linuxpluginupgrade
options.description: Option to set plugin upgrade behaviour for Linux

options.name: locallanaccess
options.description: Set local LAN access. If split tunneling is C(OFF), and you set local LAN access to C(ON), the local client can route traffic to its local interface. When the local area network switch is specified, this combination of switches is useful. The client can allow local LAN access to devices that commonly have non-routable addresses, such as local printers or local file servers.

options.name: loginscript
options.description: Path to the logon script that is run when a session is established. Separate multiple scripts by using comma. A "$" in the path signifies that the word following the "$" is an environment variable.

options.name: logoutscript
options.description: Path to the logout script. Separate multiple scripts by using comma. A "$" in the path signifies that the word following the "$" is an environment variable.

options.name: macpluginupgrade
options.description: Option to set plugin upgrade behaviour for Mac

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: maxiipperuser
options.description: Maximum number of Intranet IP that can be assigned to a user from AAA group, VPN vserver or VPN global pool. This setting is not applicable for AAA user level Intranet IP configuration

options.name: mdxtokentimeout
options.description: Validity of MDX Token in minutes. This token is used for mdx services to access backend and valid  HEAD and GET request.

options.name: netmask
options.description: The netmask for the spoofed ip address

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: ntdomain
options.description: Single sign-on domain to use for single sign-on to applications in the internal network. This setting can be overwritten by the domain that users specify at the time of logon or by the domain that the authentication server returns.

options.name: pcoipprofilename
options.description: Name of the PCOIP profile.

options.name: proxy
options.description: Set options to apply proxy for accessing the internal resources. Available settings function as follows: * C(BROWSER) - Proxy settings are configured only in Internet Explorer and Firefox browsers. * C(NS) - Proxy settings are configured on the Citrix ADC. * C(OFF) - Proxy settings are not configured.

options.name: proxyexception
options.description: Proxy exception string that will be configured in the browser for bypassing the previously configured proxies. Allowed only if proxy type is Browser.

options.name: proxylocalbypass
options.description: Bypass proxy server for local addresses option in Internet Explorer and Firefox proxy server settings.

options.name: rdpclientprofilename
options.description: Name of the RDP profile associated with the vserver.

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: rfc1918
options.description: As defined in the local area network, allow only the following local area network addresses to bypass the VPN tunnel when the local LAN access feature is enabled: * 10.*.*.*, * 172.16.*.*, * 192.168.*.*

options.name: samesite
options.description: SameSite attribute value for Cookies generated in VPN context. This attribute value will be appended only for the cookies which are specified in the builtin patset ns_cookies_samesite

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: securebrowse
options.description: Allow users to connect through Citrix Gateway to network resources from iOS and Android mobile devices with Citrix Receiver. Users do not need to establish a full VPN tunnel to access resources in the secure network.

options.name: secureprivateaccess
options.description: Enables or disables the secure private access configuration.

options.name: sesstimeout
options.description: Number of minutes after which the session times out.

options.name: smartgroup
options.description: This is the default group that is chosen when the authentication succeeds in addition to extracted groups.

options.name: socksproxy
options.description: IP address of the proxy server to be used for SOCKS access for all subsequent connections to the internal network.

options.name: splitdns
options.description: Route the DNS requests to the local DNS server configured on the user device, or Citrix Gateway (remote), or both.

options.name: splittunnel
options.description: Send, through the tunnel, traffic only for intranet applications that are defined in Citrix Gateway. Route all other traffic directly to the Internet. The C(OFF) setting routes all traffic through Citrix Gateway. With the C(REVERSE) setting, intranet applications define the network traffic that is not intercepted. All network traffic directed to internal IP addresses bypasses the VPN tunnel, while other traffic goes through Citrix Gateway. Reverse split tunneling can be used to log all non-local

options.name: spoofiip
options.description: Indicate whether or not the application requires IP spoofing, which routes the connection to the intranet application through the virtual adapter.

options.name: sslproxy
options.description: IP address of the proxy server to be used for SSL access for all subsequent connections to the internal network.

options.name: sso
options.description: Set single sign-on (SSO) for the session. When the user accesses a server, the user's logon credentials are passed to the server for authentication. 	    NOTE : This configuration does not honor the following authentication types for security reason. BASIC, DIGEST, and NTLM (without Negotiate NTLM2 Key or Negotiate Sign Flag). Use VPN TrafficAction to configure SSO for these authentication types.

options.name: ssocredential
options.description: Specify whether to use the primary or secondary authentication credentials for single sign-on to the server.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(unset), the resource will be unset on the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: storefronturl
options.description: Web address for StoreFront to be used in this session for enumeration of resources from XenApp or XenDesktop.

options.name: transparentinterception
options.description: Allow access to network resources by using a single IP address and subnet mask or a range of IP addresses. The C(OFF) setting sets the mode to proxy, in which you configure destination and source IP addresses and port numbers. If you are using the Citrix Gateway Plug-in for Windows, set this parameter to C(ON), in which the mode is set to transparent. If you are using the Citrix Gateway Plug-in for Java, set this parameter to C(OFF).

options.name: uitheme
options.description: Set VPN UI Theme to Green-Bubble, Caxton or Custom; default is Caxton.

options.name: useiip
options.description: Define IP address pool options. Available settings function as follows: * C(SPILLOVER) - When an address pool is configured and the mapped IP is used as an intranet IP address, the mapped IP address is used when an intranet IP address cannot be assigned. * C(NOSPILLOVER) - When intranet IP addresses are enabled and the mapped IP address is not used, the Transfer Login page appears for users who have used all available intranet IP addresses. * C(OFF) - Address pool is not configured.

options.name: usemip
options.description: Enable or disable the use of a unique IP address alias, or a mapped IP address, as the client IP address for each client session. Allow Citrix Gateway to use the mapped IP address as an intranet IP address when all other IP addresses are not available. When IP pooling is configured and the mapped IP is used as an intranet IP address, the mapped IP address is used when an intranet IP address cannot be assigned.

options.name: userdomains
options.description: List of user domains specified as comma seperated value

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: wihome
options.description: Web address of the Web Interface server, such as http://<ipAddress>/Citrix/XenApp, or Receiver for Web, which enumerates the virtualized resources, such as XenApp, XenDesktop, and cloud applications. This web address is used as the home page in ICA proxy mode. If Client Choices is ON, you must configure this setting. Because the user can choose between FullClient and ICAProxy, the user may see a different home page. An Internet web site may appear if the user gets the FullClient option, or a Web

options.name: wihomeaddresstype
options.description: Type of the wihome address(C(IPV4)/V6)

options.name: windowsautologon
options.description: Enable or disable the Windows Auto Logon for the session. If a VPN session is established after this setting is enabled, the user is automatically logged on by using Windows credentials after the system is restarted.

options.name: windowsclienttype
options.description: The Windows client type. Choose between two types of Windows Client\ a) Application Agent - which always runs in the task bar as a standalone application and also has a supporting service which runs permanently when installed\ b) Activex Control - ActiveX control run by Microsoft Internet Explorer.

options.name: windowspluginupgrade
options.description: Option to set plugin upgrade behaviour for Win

options.name: winsip
options.description: WINS server IP address to add to Citrix Gateway for name resolution.

options.name: wiportalmode
options.description: Layout on the Access Interface. The C(COMPACT) value indicates the use of small icons.
